messages.confirmDisableAiProfile: This will disable AI capabilities for this account member. Continue?

tooltips.aiMessageVisibility: Public & Private allows customer-facing messages and internal notes. Private only restricts this AI to internal notes, including replies to customer messages and mentions. WhatsApp templates and automated follow-up outreach are disabled while Private only is selected.
tooltips.tasksEnabled: Allow this AI to manage conversation tasks assigned to the configured human users. Requires CRM API access and at least one eligible assignee.
tooltips.taskManagementPrompt: Internal instructions for when to create, update, complete or cancel tasks, deadlines, and fallback assignment. Never quoted to the customer.
tooltips.taskAssignees: Select active human CRM users in this account's tenant and teams. Edit Internal Notes beside each user to explain when this AI should assign work to them.
tooltips.followupsEnabled: When disabled, this AI agent never runs automated follow-ups: new opportunities it creates are NOT armed with a follow-up loop, scheduled follow-ups for opportunities it drives stop firing, and any opportunities currently in 'Follow-up Active' driven by this agent are reset to 'Action Needed' the moment you disable it. The agent can still create and update opportunities normally.
tooltips.followupBreakoutLimit: Agent-level default for the maximum number of consecutive follow-ups before a deal is auto-Ended. Leave empty for non-deterministic behaviour (the AI chooses per deal; deals without an explicit value fall back to 3). When set, this default applies deterministically to every deal driven by this agent — unless the deal carries its own explicit Follow-up Breakout Limit (set by the AI or via mass-update), which always wins.
tooltips.aiDebounceSeconds: How long the AI waits (in seconds) after the customer's last message before it starts processing a reply. New messages arriving during this window reset the wait, so rapid message bursts are answered once. Defaults to 1 second when the agent cannot be resolved yet (e.g. first message before assignment).
tooltips.delegateEnabled: When enabled, this AI agent may call the OpenCode `delegate` tool for multi-step research in each customer's isolated contact workspace (AI-profile skills/modes are copied as a baseline; contact overrides are preserved). Leave OFF unless you want untrusted conversation content to trigger nested agent runs in contact sandboxes. Requires the AI membership's assigned CRM user (for baseline skills/modes) and a linked CRM Contact on the conversation.
tooltips.whatsappMessageTemplates: Select Meta-approved WhatsApp message templates this AI may send on WhatsApp Cloud / Coexistence inboxes it belongs to. At runtime the AI only sees templates for the conversation's inbox, and only when the 24-hour customer-service window is closed (free-form messaging is unavailable). Templates are loaded from the linked inbox's Meta Business Account.
tooltips.chatwootAccountUserId: The account-user membership ID in Chat. This field is automatically populated after sync.
tooltips.chatwootInboxes: The inboxes this account member has access to. Managed automatically by the inbox member sync.
tooltips.isAI: Enable to configure this member as an AI-powered agent.
tooltips.aiPrompt: The system prompt that defines the AI agent's behavior and capabilities.
tooltips.timeZone: IANA timezone used for conversation-history timestamps and the current date/time in the AI prompt (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo). Leave empty to use UTC. Calendar booking still uses each managed calendar's own timezone.
tooltips.knowledgeBaseCategories: Select knowledge base categories. Articles in these categories (and their sub-categories) will be available for AI-powered responses.
tooltips.calendarsToManage: Select users whose calendars this AI agent can manage. The agent can check availability, create, update, and delete appointments for these calendars. Use the "Internal Notes" column next to each calendar to record per-professional guidance (internal use — never quoted verbatim to the customer).
tooltips.calendarDescription: Internal text (up to ~4000 chars) describing per-professional/location guidance — e.g. service types, age restrictions, prep instructions. Injected into the AI agent's system prompt but NEVER quoted verbatim to the customer.
tooltips.calendarEventType: Which CRM entity type the AI agent should create when booking for this calendar. Appointment is the default; Meeting and Call are also supported.
tooltips.funnelsToManage: Select the opportunity funnels this AI agent can manage. The agent can create, update, and delete opportunities in these funnels. Use the "Internal Notes" column next to each funnel to record per-funnel guidance (internal use — never quoted verbatim to the customer).
tooltips.description: Internal text (up to ~4000 chars) describing per-funnel guidance — e.g. value restrictions, target audience, qualification criteria. Injected into the AI agent's system prompt but NEVER quoted verbatim to the customer.
tooltips.globalAdmin: Grants account-wide inbox visibility for administrators. When disabled, an administrator only sees inboxes they are a member of (directly or via team ownership). Mirrored automatically from Chat (source of truth) — manage it there.
